lessons_used: Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign), path selection redesigns (choose_path, redesign), and path copy reframing (choose_path, copy) proved helpful, each producing one winning test alongside tests with no clear effect.
Sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) and waiting screen info updates (home, wait_info) consistently showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
New finish screens (finish, new_screen), sign-in reordering (sign_in, reorder), and sign-in layout changes (sign_in, layout) did not help, resulting in worse outcomes or no clear effect.
Evidence remains thin for categories tested only once, such as adoption new flows, adoption incentives, home redesigns, and finish notifications.
Predictions were generally overly optimistic, though they underestimated the true impact of winning path selection redesigns and copy changes.

candidates.title: Split Screen Interactive Preview Redesign for Pick Friend
candidates.change: Redesign the Pick Friend screen using a split layout showing a live companion preview side-by-side with choice cards.
candidates.why: Adoption has a steep dropoff (65.9% conversion) and long completion times (median 89s). Redesigning adoption screens proved successful in past tests.

pick_friend.headline: Meet Your New Desktop Companion
pick_friend.body: Select a personality style to see how your companion interacts on your screen.

guard.reason: Redesigns Pick Friend screen with split preview while preserving pet selection functionality.

candidates.score_note: Adoption redesigns have a proven track record (+2.3% avg lift), though layout redesign requires new release.

candidates.title: Daily Companion Value Framing Copy for Path Selection
candidates.change: Update the Choose Path headline and body to emphasize daily companionship routines and desk focus benefits.
candidates.why: Path copy reframing produced winning tests previously, and choose_path shows high drop-off relative to its brevity (80.3% conversion, 514s mean).

choose_path.headline: How Would You Like Your Companion to Help You Today?
choose_path.body: Choose focus companion mode for quiet work sessions or playful mode for lively desktop check-ins throughout your day.

guard.reason: Copy changes the Path Selection choice to focus vs. playful modes, losing the required job of offering adopting vs. making your own pet.

candidates.title: Pre-Adoption Companion Confirmation Screen
candidates.change: Insert a new companion confirmation screen (new_pet_preview) before generating the adoption certificate.
candidates.why: Support emails show users report custom pet generation failures or unexpected results (3 emails). Giving a confirmation preview sets clear expectations before creation.

new_pet_preview.headline: Confirm Your Companion's Personality & Look
new_pet_preview.body: Review your companion's traits before finalizing adoption.

guard.reason: new screens need an _order that places them

candidates.title: Companion Starter Pack Incentive on Waiting Screen
candidates.change: Display a desktop companion starter pack reward banner on the waiting screen while pet generation finishes.
candidates.why: The waiting screen has the longest delay in onboarding (median 201s, mean 2336s). Providing a reward incentive rewards patience during long load times.

waiting.headline: Your Companion is Preparing Their Desk Corner!
waiting.body: While we build your desktop pet, we've unlocked a Starter Care Pack for your first week together.

guard.reason: Mentions unlocked starter packs/free extras in onboarding copy.

candidates.title: Full Bleed Desktop Launch Redesign for Home Intro Screen
candidates.change: Redesign the home intro screen into a full-bleed visual layout emphasizing desktop activation.
candidates.why: Finish screen conversion is only 64.8% with 395s median time, and 3 support emails reported pets not showing on desktop after setup.

home_intro.headline: Your Desktop Companion is Ready to Move In!
home_intro.body: Click launch to place your companion on your screen taskbar.

guard.reason: replacement for 'home_intro.home_welcome' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'] with real words

candidates.title: Grid Layout Redesign for Path Selection
candidates.change: Redesign path selection into a structured grid layout with visual path badges.
candidates.why: Path selection redesigns previously generated strong positive results. Rebuilding the path selection UI can improve early funnel engagement.

guard.reason: replacement for 'choose_path.path_options' does not do the job (two distinct choices: adopting a friend and making your own): needs 2 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Interactive Trait Summary Sub-Flow during Adoption
candidates.change: Add an interactive trait selection checklist component to the adoption certificate screen.
candidates.why: Adoption stage has high dropoff (65.9%) and long completion times. Adding interactive customization elements strengthens emotional connection.

components.text: Choose starting habits: Desk Reminders, Water Breaks, High-Fives

guard.reason: Adds a trait checklist component to the adoption certificate screen without removing the required official stamp or functionality.

candidates.score_note: New flows in adoption showed negative historical results (-5.7%) and require high dev effort.

candidates.title: Desktop Controls & Visibility Guidance Copy on Home Intro
candidates.change: Add clear instruction copy explaining how to summon, minimize, and interact with the desktop pet right on the final screen.
candidates.why: Support received multiple tickets (3 emails regarding controls/hiding, 3 emails regarding pet not showing on desktop). Clear finish copy resolves confusion.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Live on Your Screen!
home_intro.body: Press Option/Alt + Space anytime to show or hide your pet. Right-click your pet to open quick actions and settings.

guard.reason: Updates home intro copy with desktop control instructions within allowed onboarding modifications.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from support emails and funnel dropoff; low-cost copy-only update.

candidates.title: Photo Upload Guidance Copy for Custom Pet Generation
candidates.change: Update headline and body on the photo upload screen to give clear pet photo lighting and framing guidance.
candidates.why: Users emailed support about custom pet generation failing or looking wrong (3 emails). Better upload copy improves input quality.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Clear, Well-Lit Photos of Your Pet
upload_photos.body: For best avatar results, use a centered front-facing photo with good lighting and clear background contrast.

candidates.title: Desktop Ready Audio & Visual Alert Component on Waiting Screen
candidates.change: Add a completion alert audio trigger and notification badge to the waiting screen when processing finishes.
candidates.why: Waiting step takes mean 2336s (median 201s). Users step away from desktop and drop off before completing onboarding.

guard.reason: Adds audio alert and ready notification trigger to the waiting screen within onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Home notifications previously showed negative lift (-0.2%) with thin evidence of user issue.

lessons_next: Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign), path selection redesigns (choose_path, redesign), and path copy reframing (choose_path, copy) proved helpful, each delivering a winning test.
Sign-in hints (sign_in, hint), waiting screen info updates (home, wait_info), and waiting screen notifications (home, notification) consistently showed no clear effect across multiple tests.

New finish screens (finish, new_screen), finish redesigns (finish, redesign), sign-in reordering (sign_in, reorder), and sign-in layout changes (sign_in, layout) produced no winning tests, resulting in no clear effect or worse outcomes.
Evidence remains thin for single-test categories, including adoption new flows, adoption incentives, path selection layouts, finish notifications, home screen layouts, and home screen redesigns.
Predictions were generally overly optimistic, though they underestimated the impact of winning path selection redesigns and copy changes.
